sections.title: Its look shows how it has been cared for -- and the app shows its stats
lines: Its look shows how it has been cared for — REST, HUNGER, THIRST, WEIGHT (0 its balance, bounded) and COMPANIONSHIP, derived from two weeks of tending (care.ts); a short night shadows its eyes, three bloodshot them, hunger thins it and no training fattens it, hunger and thirst cost mood and push SAD; drawn by every host as pose.girth and eye patches; the app's daemon card shows the stats (DRAFT, not yet on a device)
